description:
A presentation deck owned by a terminal issue previews as an eligible plan through the document target form and the container target form, closing the gap that forced the predecessor deck to be relocated by hand.

## Background

Archiving the predecessor showcase deck had to be hand-rolled because the presentation area was outside the managed paths. That bypass skipped the planner's reference remapping, left a document reference dangling, and caused a validation failure that had to be repaired by hand. A preview over the predecessor container reproduces the gap with blockers on an architecture document, a successor deck, and a tombstone.

With the areas classified, out-of-root artifacts classified permanent, and directory targets skipped, both target forms should reach eligibility. The assertion reads the target-level blocker array as well as the per-artifact one, because a selected-root blocker is recorded at target level and never appears in artifact action counts.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A document-target preview of a deck asset owned by a terminal issue reports an eligible plan.
- [hard] REQ-02: A container-target preview whose subtree contains a deck owned by a terminal issue reports an eligible plan.
- [hard] REQ-03: Neither preview reports an unmanaged-selected-root blocker for a path under a configured development area, asserted against the target-level blocker array.
title: Prove deck archival is eligible through both archive target forms
